description: This file defines interfaces and classes for chat events within the Orleans framework, including creation, posting, deletion, and editing events. Each event implements the IChatEvent interface with an Update method to modify an XML document representing the chat state.

classes.name: IChatEvent
classes.description: Interface for all chat events, defining a method to update an XML document.

classes.name: CreatedEvent
classes.description: Represents a chat creation event, initializing the chat state within an XML document.

classes.name: PostedEvent
classes.description: Represents a message being posted in the chat, adding a new post to the XML document.

classes.name: DeletedEvent
classes.description: Represents a deletion of a chat message identified by a GUID, removing it from the XML document.

classes.name: EditedEvent
classes.description: Represents editing an existing chat message, modifying its text in the XML document.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Method implemented by each event class to update the XML document based on the event type.
